purpose: Exhaust the distinct team-total to full-game-total monotone payoff graph from the already retained Patriots-Seahawks exact event without another request.

payoff_proof.state_variables: nonnegative integer Patriots and Seahawks final scores including overtime if played
payoff_proof.relation: For team threshold T and full-game threshold G with T greater than or equal to G, team Over T implies game Over G. Therefore team Under T plus game Over G pays at least one pUSD in every completed score state.
payoff_proof.cancellation: Both retained markets resolve 50-50 when canceled with no make-up game, so the two legs total one pUSD in that state.
payoff_proof.postponement: Both retained markets remain open until the same game is completed.
payoff_proof.package: YES(team Under T) plus YES(game Over G)
payoff_proof.excluded_market_types: First-half, second-half, and quarter totals are not included because their retained horizon and overtime semantics are not identical to the full-game total.
